name: Hatta Madori
source:
Madori is Takaya's kouhai. While being small, this girl has a bust size of 88cm, and an F cup. Woo~! She often uses this trait to “seduce” Takaya for fun, as well as to ignore a topic she doesn’t want to talk about.

[spoiler] She always has her top hat on, which is later revealed to have a mind its own.[/spoiler]

[From [url=https://vnerogereview.wordpress.com/2013/12/16/strong-desire-makes-wishes-come-true-review-of-131129amatarasu-riddle-star/]Eroge Review[/url]]
